admission.justification: Guarded by CompactToolResultWireTests and prevents reintroducing private SDK monkeypatching, indented refusal payloads, or placeholder DictOutput schemas and duplicate structuredContent on generic dict tools.

applicability: Every normal tool return value and early-return guard refusal converted to CallToolResult in AgentsRememberMCP.
conditions: build_call_tool_result emits compact single-line UTF-8 JSON text blocks and attaches schema-validated structured_content only when a StructuredOutputSpec is present (typed BaseModel or non-generic returns), omitting outputSchema and structured_content for bare dict, dict[str, Any], dict[str, object], and bare-dict explainer tools.
build_early_refusal_result emits compact single-line UTF-8 JSON text via compact_json_text with structured_content=None for explainer forged-seat and stale-build early refusals.
exclusions: Application-layer tool_response.py, which imports no MCP SDK types and stays transport-independent.

evidence: pytest mcp/tests/test_compact_content.py mcp/tests/test_suite_load_independence.py + compare_wire_baseline.py vs start-tree-wire-baseline.json

statement: The retired compact_content monkeypatch is replaced by build_call_tool_result and build_early_refusal_result in tool_results.py, constructing compact single-line UTF-8 JSON CallToolResult objects in the MCP adapter with no placeholder DictOutput schema or duplicate structuredContent on generic dict tools, bare-dict explainer tools, or early-return transport refusals, while typed BaseModel tools retain outputSchema and validated structuredContent.
title: MCP adapter builds compact CallToolResult and compact early refusals
